stemBlocks:
Scientists studied the processes by which drugs cross the cell membrane and enter cells.
The rate of uptake of four drugs, P, Q, R and S, was studied at $4\ ^\circ\text{C}$ and at $37\ ^\circ\text{C}$. The results are shown in the chart. All other variables were kept constant.
Which of the following conclusions can be drawn from the results?

1 The percentage increase in rate of uptake of R from $4\ ^\circ\text{C}$ to $37\ ^\circ\text{C}$ is 2.5 times more than the percentage increase in the rate of uptake of S.
2 The concentration of Q must be the same inside and outside the cell.
3 P must be transported across the cell membrane using active transport only.

assets.alt: Key: dark grey bar = experiment performed at $4\ ^\circ\text{C}$, light grey bar = experiment performed at $37\ ^\circ\text{C}$. Y-axis: rate of uptake of drug / arbitrary units. X-axis: drug studied (P, Q, R, S).
